posts.text: I know a lot of people have already posted about it. But it's really just... I don't know. The president is selling 6-figure access to his social media feed so Wall Street algorithms can beat you to the punch and fleece you before news even hits your phone. He's making millions on a system designed to give a massive advantage to major corporate traders who can afford a feed that gives them information first. It's the single most corrupt thing I've ever seen a politician do with their office. Lit

posts.text:
Just in the last 24 hours, we learned...

1. In 2021, Capital One closed the Trump Org's bank accounts after an anti-money-laundering review, not as retaliation for Jan 6. 

2. Jeanine Pirro, the U.S. attorney in Washington, threw out a reflecting pool vandalism case, saying the cause was shoddy construction.

3. The Trump admin began refunding tariffs back to major corporations like Amazon and Apple who had charged and collected tariffs rev from consumers.
